family.tagline: Lesson files, bedtime stories and baby photos, all at home.
family.story: Kasia teaches math and reading to children from the neighborhood in the front study. Arun manages projects, some days from home, around a toddler and a baby. Lesson files and family photos sit on one Companion Core.

companion.name: Pia
companion.job: Drafts lesson plans and parent updates from notes Kasia texts it.
companion.limits: Drafts only. Kasia reviews and sends each one.

companion.name: Sethu
companion.job: Opens Yuvomi in its own browser and adds the week's chores and meals.

chapters.title: Out on the drive and patio

popup.title: A parcel on the porch
popup.body: A parcel waits on the porch at Pennywhistle Close. Arun carries it past the living room to the study, where Kasia clears a corner of the desk.

popup.title: Ila peeks into the parcel
popup.body: Ila peeks in. Inside: the Companion Core, a power cable, a quick-start guide and a recovery USB drive. The Core covers about three quarters of a sheet of paper.

popup.title: Plug it in
popup.body: Arun plugs in the power cable and presses the button. The Core wakes and opens its own Wi-Fi network.

popup.title: Kasia joins from her phone
popup.body: Kasia finds the Core's own Wi-Fi network on her phone and joins it. Then she chooses the home network.

popup.title: Choose the first agents
popup.body: In Companion Hub, Kasia picks Hermes and Arun picks OpenClaw. They add Companion Memory (beta), Nextcloud and Excalidraw, then walk away.

beats.capability: talks to you through the messaging platform you pick

popup.title: Pia says hello
popup.body: Kasia sends the first message to the agent she named Pia. Pia answers, and the Core is running.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: kasia
say.text: Hello, Kasia. I am Pia. Where would you like to start?

beats.capability: a family planner with a shared calendar, tasks, shopping, meals

popup.title: Sethu fills in the week
popup.body: Over coffee, Arun asks Sethu for next week's meals. Sethu opens Yuvomi in its own browser and adds them. Arun checks every line.

beats.capability: a shared grocery list, recipe book, meal planner

popup.title: Pancakes go in the recipe book
popup.body: Ila stirs the batter while Arun types the pancake recipe into KitchenOwl. It joins the family recipe book on the Core.

beats.capability: back up, search and organise your family photos and videos

popup.title: Dev's first months, on the TV
popup.body: Sunday afternoon, Arun puts an album of Dev's first months on the living-room TV. The photos come from Immich on the Core.

beats.capability: manage and read books, comics and PDFs

popup.title: A picture book on the couch
popup.body: On the couch, Kasia reads Ila a picture book from BookLore. The whole library lives on the Core.

beats.capability: plan your day, track time and run a Pomodoro timer

popup.title: Arun blocks out his day
popup.body: At the dining table, Arun plans his workday in Super Productivity and runs its timer. Kasia's lesson hours go in first.

beats.capability: your files, calendar and contacts on your own Core

popup.title: Worksheets stay in one folder
popup.body: Kasia keeps every worksheet in a Nextcloud folder on the Core. The family photos live in a different app.

beats.capability: a whiteboard with a hand-drawn look

popup.title: A number line on the whiteboard
popup.body: Before the first lesson, Kasia sketches a number line in Excalidraw. The whiteboard runs on the Core and opens in any browser at home.

beats.capability: talks to you through the messaging platform you pick

popup.title: Pia drafts, Kasia sends
popup.body: After the last lesson, Kasia texts Pia her notes. Pia drafts each family's update, and Kasia sends it herself.

say.speaker: kasia
say.text: Here are the drafts. Please read each one before you send it.

beats.capability: a PDF toolkit that runs in your browser

popup.title: Term worksheets, one PDF
popup.body: Kasia merges the term's worksheets into one PDF with BentoPDF. The toolkit runs in the browser, and nothing is uploaded.

beats.capability: send invoices and quotes, track expenses and time

popup.title: Invoices from the same desk
popup.body: At month end, Kasia writes an invoice for each family in Invoice Ninja. The invoices and the hours behind them sit on the Core.

beats.capability: block ads, trackers and bad domains for every device on your network

popup.title: Ad blocking for the whole Wi-Fi
popup.body: Arun opens Pi-hole on the Core. It blocks ad and tracker domains for every device on the home Wi-Fi, phones and laptops included.

beats.capability: stream your own music from your Core to a browser or an app

popup.title: A lullaby from the collection
popup.body: At bedtime, Kasia plays the lullaby her mother sang. mStream sends it from the family's music collection on the Core to her phone.

beats.capability: edit audio in a browser tab. Cut, fade, normalise, export

popup.title: A birthday song, trimmed
popup.body: Arun records a birthday song on his guitar for Ila. He trims the take in AudioMass, an audio editor that opens in a browser tab.

beats.capability: point it at a camera on your network and it finds the stream address

popup.title: Strix finds the camera
popup.body: Arun points Strix at the new camera on the drive. It finds the stream address and writes the Frigate configuration.

beats.capability: save articles to read later without a hosted bookmarking service

popup.title: Saved to read on the patio
popup.body: After bedtime, Kasia reads a teaching article on the patio. She saved it to Readeck, which keeps it on the Core.

popup.title: One Core, one busy house
popup.body: The Nowak-Pillai household runs worksheets, photos, bedtime stories and two agents from one Core in the study.

closing.body: Your worksheets, your family photos and your bedtime stories can sit on a Companion Core at home. Open the Companion Hub store and pick your first apps.

notes: FTUE follows the owner's hotspot flow (STORY-BIBLE section 7); owner sign-off against the fact sheet is still open.
Students are minors: beats show where lesson files live and never name a student. No safety or learning-outcome claim anywhere.
garden-drive assumes the family owns an IP camera (not in the Core parcel, not in the 3D scene). Strix finds its stream address; Frigate keeps the clips. No claim that it prevents anything.
study-update: Hermes drafts, Kasia sends. Pia is the Drafter persona with Companion Memory connected, opt-in.
Invented place and street (Corvine Hill, Pennywhistle Close): check both against a map before launch.
